title: AP Mapper Configuration
description: Configuration options for the AP Mapper Nautobot app.

supported_targets.description: List of object types that can be placed on maps (app_label.model_name).

marker_default_color.description: Default hex color for map markers.

marker_size.description: Size of map markers in pixels.

background_max_bytes.description: Maximum file size for background images in bytes.

background_max_dimension.description: Maximum dimension (width or height) for background images in pixels.
